_about: The 10 niche slots shown on Gen-Visual, in display order. `title` is a COSMETIC label for the switcher pill only — it is independent of niche_brief.json's `niche` field (the AI content-generation vocabulary) and editing it here never touches that file. Assigned slots (site_id set) point at a real master site under sites/; blank slots (site_id null) have no site yet and exist purely as a reserved, nameable placeholder.
